Senior Backend Engineer — Ground Platform
Acme Rockets · Austin, TX or Remote (US)

About the role
Our ground platform ingests telemetry from every flight and turns it into the dashboards our launch team relies on.
You will own services that process millions of telemetry points per minute.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate Node.js services that ingest and query rocket telemetry
- Own the PostgreSQL schema and query performance for our time-series data
- Lead design reviews and write clear technical proposals
- Mentor two mid-level engineers on the team
- Take part in a one-week on-call rotation every six weeks

What you need
- 5+ years of professional backend development experience
- Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript in production
- Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, including indexing and query planning
- Experience designing REST APIs used by other teams
- Clear written communication; we work async across time zones
- You have mentored or coached other engineers

Bonus points for
- Experience with Kafka or another streaming platform
- Familiarity with Rust
- Background in aerospace or other safety-critical industries
